title: Funktionalanalysis (TUM, Modul MA3001)
description:
- Banach and Hilbert spaces; - Bounded linear operators, open mapping theorem; - Spectral theory for compact selfadjoint operators; - Duality, Hahn-Banach theorems; - Weak and weak* convergence; - Brief introduction to unbounded operators

**Voraussetzungen / Prerequisites:**
MA0001 Analysis 1, MA0002 Analysis 2, MA0004 Linear Algebra 1, MA0005 Linear Algebra 2 and Discrete Structures (or CIT1130005 Linear Algebra 2 and CIT1130011 Discrete Mathematics)

goals.title: Lernergebnis
goals.description: After successful completion of the module students are able to understand and apply basic theoretical techniques to analyze linear functionals and operators on Banach and Hilbert spaces. In particular, they can analyze spectra of compact selfadjoint operators, understand the notion of duality and can apply concepts of weak and weak-star convergence in Banach spaces.
